# lcf-strain-life

> An AI-agent-native toolkit for fatigue analysis of materials. A Python library
> plus an MCP server that reduce strain-controlled fatigue test data, fit the
> standard strain-life models, estimate constants from monotonic properties,
> count variable-amplitude histories, screen data for outliers, predict life,
> and cite the published source of every method, all callable by AI agents
> over MCP.

This file indexes the project for language models. All analysis uses true stress
and true strain. Stress is in MPa, strain is a dimensionless fraction, and the
fatigue exponents b and c are negative. Links are absolute so this file works
from the repository and from the website root alike.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/dfieser/lcf-strain-life/blob/main/README.md): overview, install, quick start for the library and the MCP server.
- [Agent usage guide](https://github.com/dfieser/lcf-strain-life/blob/main/docs/AGENT_USAGE.md): the MCP tools, their units, and the compute, save, recall pattern.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/dfieser/lcf-strain-life/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for agents working on the repository.
- [Documentation site](https://dfieser.github.io/lcf-strain-life/docs/): rendered installation, usage, tutorial, statistics guide, and API reference.
- [Wiki](https://github.com/dfieser/lcf-strain-life/wiki): client setup, validation status, FAQ, and troubleshooting.

## Data and interchange

- [Interchange specification](https://github.com/dfieser/lcf-strain-life/blob/main/docs/INTERCHANGE.md): the versioned JSON formats for material constants, test records, and dataset collections, with JSON Schemas in [docs/schemas/](https://github.com/dfieser/lcf-strain-life/tree/main/docs/schemas).
- [Seed collection](https://github.com/dfieser/lcf-strain-life/blob/main/docs/data/seed_collection.json): the citable seed dataset, six SAE 1137 tests and three verified constant sets.
- [Contributing data](https://github.com/dfieser/lcf-strain-life/blob/main/docs/CONTRIBUTING-DATA.md): provenance, licensing, and metadata rules for contributed records.

## Physics and changes

- [Physics review](https://github.com/dfieser/lcf-strain-life/blob/main/docs/PHYSICS_REVIEW.md): every equation defined and cited, for specialist review. The typeset version with a sign-off table is [PHYSICS_REVIEW.pdf](https://github.com/dfieser/lcf-strain-life/blob/main/docs/PHYSICS_REVIEW.pdf).
- [Changelog](https://github.com/dfieser/lcf-strain-life/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): the chronological log of changes.
